title: Round 40: swap and route declaration rewrites from the committed IDLs (R39-CORE-DECISION-4), and the instructions no committed IDL has (R39-SUPPLY-CHAIN-11)
rule: graphite-core/src/state_diff.rs DeclaredEffects::parse / covers_by_name / debit_names_no_account (R33-5): only a line that names accounts.<x> declares that account's debit for the signer judgements; a debit line naming no account refuses a signer's token debit (SignerTokenDebitUnderUnscopedDebit) unless GRAPHITE_ALLOW_UNREADABLE_VALUE_DECLARATIONS is on. Credits are never judged.
method: The Round 36 F-005 method, applied to the 'd' rows of tests/round39_decision_campaigns.rs::round39_swap_declaration_census (93 at 1ae2066).

For each row the committed IDL instruction was read (graphite-core/scripts/out/onchain_idls/<program>.json, or the IDL file named in idl_source); rows whose program has no committed IDL for the instruction, and rows whose IDL layout holds no user-side input account, were left unchanged and are listed in left_unchanged with the reason.

Every line that declared an effect without naming an account, and every line of prose no effect word could be read in, was removed; the generated 'modifies writable accounts: ...' lines and bare identifiers (which declare nothing) were kept. The new lines each name an account for every effect they declare.

Roles follow the grammar: an account after 'from' takes the debit, after 'to'/'into' only the credit, otherwise every effect of the line. The user's input account is the only user-side account named as debited; the user's output account, fee, referral, host, commission and beneficiary accounts are credit-only. Where the IDL sets the direction by an argument (a_to_b, xToY, swap0to1, the order side), both of the user's accounts are named as debited, each under its condition in prose: L4 does not read the condition (a residual, below).

No line uses a word that would declare an effect it does not mean: no 'mint' (a mint effect), 'owner' (authority), 'fee'/'pay' (debit), 'open'/'init'/'create', 'close', 'delegate', 'approve', 'signer'; the mint and burn lines of Meteora DAMM v1 swap name only its two vault LP mints, which its IDL says are minted to and burned from on the vault deposit and withdrawal.

Checked by a Python port of DeclaredEffects::parse (each added line declares an effect, none unscoped; the whole declaration has a named debit), against the layout (every named account in every layout, the layout in the IDL's order), against the IDL (every named account writable and not a signer), against L7 Check 8 (a credit or output word remains) and the drainer heuristic (no declaration got shorter). The same checks run in validate_corpora.py (rewrites section) and in tests/round40_swap_declarations.rs with the real parser.

Confidence high when the IDL's docs, or its account names themselves, state whose account it is and its direction (input/output, user_..._in/out, source/destination, or docs as Orca's 'token_authority - The authority to withdraw tokens from the input token account' with the a_to_b argument documented); medium when the IDL carries no docs and the direction is an argument read from its name only, or the names do not say whose account it is.
